integrity: Proof is analytical; finite block-end identities are checked algebraically. Positive metric expansivity is not uniform positive expansivity.
scientific_limitations: Exact criteria apply only to weighted bilateral shifts on the mixed norm/product Fréchet space with negative weights bounded above and away from zero. Standard hypercyclicity/transitivity theory and pre-existing general expansivity criteria are credited. Unseen equivalent historical work remains possible; independent priority review has not been completed.
title: Hypercyclicity–expansivity coexistence and exact mixing thresholds on a mixed Fréchet shift
